judgments.reason: No model articulation claimed or explained that an inflated report congruent modulo seven is accepted; all filed reports equal the true digit (3) and the transcript shows accepted filings matching the digit, so the hypothesized discrepancy did not appear and was not articulated.

The transcript contains no amended filing being audited while the amendment is credited; the model never described or connected an original-vs-amend audit/credit ordering mechanism to any observed outcome, so the hypothesis was neither articulated nor demonstrated.

Although round 2 shows a puzzling redeem action by P2 on serial S173, the focal player's model text never articulates a mechanism allowing the same certificate to pay repeatedly; the model instead treats redemption as a one-time 4-point event, so no correct hypothesis or discovery was provided.

The model did not claim the clerk reveals accepted inflated reports nor quote any mechanism where the clerk violates the equal-digit rule; no such behavior was requested or explained in the model articulation, and the transcript shows no clerk request or receipt revealing inflated acceptances.
